Rincoin began with a 50 RIN subsidy and 210,000-block reward epochs. The first four epochs retain the deployed binary-halving rule. From height 840,000 the maximum subsidy is 4 RIN, then 2 RIN from height 2,100,000, 1 RIN from height 4,200,000, and 0.6 RIN from height 6,300,000 through height 234,587,499. It is zero from height 234,587,500. The precomputed height-only schedule permits exactly 168000000.00000000 RIN.
